title: Auditing M-LLMs for Privacy Risks: A Synthetic Benchmark and Evaluation Framework
reasoning: The paper introduces the PRISM benchmark, which specifically includes 'Religious-Belief (REG)' as one of the twelve sensitive attributes used to evaluate the inference capabilities of multi-modal large language models. Additionally, the authors discuss the ethical imperatives and challenges of conducting privacy research, justifying the use of synthetic data to avoid ethical violations associated with real-world user data.
